t: You're looking at the Kings Head, a pub in Southwark. Its name points to Henry VIII, who was King of England from 1509 until his death in 1547, and later King of Ireland too, from 1542. Pubs called the King's Head are named for a monarch, and here that monarch is Henry. That's about all the material I have on this particular pub, so I'll leave it there. Have a look at the sign and the frontage, and imagine the king it's named for.
